name: Cube 2: Sauerbraten
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The free old-school deathmatch shooter with co-op map editing. Installs the newest Sauerbraten server, checked against SourceForge's checksum, and runs on ARM through Box64.
startup: b=; command -v box64 >/dev/null && b=box64; BOX64_LOG=0 exec $b ./linux_64_server

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Cube 2: Sauerbraten. Downloads the newest Sauerbraten release for Linux
# from SourceForge and keeps only the server from it, checked against
# SourceForge's checksum. server-init.cfg (your settings) is never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
ua="raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

rss=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "https://sourceforge.net/projects/sauerbraten/rss?path=/sauerbraten") ||
    fail "SourceForge can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
# The newest Linux release and its checksum, from the project's file feed.
item=$(tr -d '\r\n' <<<"$rss" | sed 's#</item>#&\n#g' | grep -E '<link>[^<]*_linux\.tar\.bz2/download</link>' | sed -n 1p)
url=$(sed -nE 's#.*<link>([^<]*_linux\.tar\.bz2/download)</link>.*#\1#p' <<<"$item")
md5=$(sed -nE 's#.*<media:hash algo="md5">([0-9a-f]{32})</media:hash>.*#\1#p' <<<"$item")
[ -n "$url" ] && [ -n "$md5" ] || fail "SourceForge's file list had no Linux release. Reinstall to try again later."
file=${url%/download}; file=${file##*/}
release=$(sed -E 's/^sauerbraten_([0-9_]+)_.*/\1/' <<<"$file" | tr _ -)

if [ -x linux_64_server ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$file" ]; then
    echo "Sauerbraten $release is already installed."
else
    rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/x"
    # The release is about 1 GB of game data; only the server is kept.
    echo "Downloading Sauerbraten $release (about 1 GB, of which the server keeps a few files)"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$build/s.tar.bz2" "$url" || fail "The download from SourceForge failed. Reinstall to try again."
    [ "$(md5sum "$build/s.tar.bz2" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$md5" ] || fail "The download didn't match SourceForge's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xjf "$build/s.tar.bz2" -C "$build/x" --wildcards '*/bin_unix/linux_64_server' '*/server-init.cfg' ||
        fail "Sauerbraten's download has no Linux server in it."
    bin=$(find "$build/x" -name linux_64_server -type f | sed -n 1p)
    chmod +x "$bin"
    mv -f "$bin" linux_64_server
    [ -f server-init.cfg ] || mv "$(find "$build/x" -name server-init.cfg | sed -n 1p)" server-init.cfg
    echo "$file" > .raptor-version
fi
# The settings the server's variables set, as lines Raptor can rewrite at
# each start (the game's own file has them commented out).
for k in serverport maxclients serverdesc serverpass adminpass mastername; do
    grep -q "^$k " server-init.cfg || echo "$k \"\"" >> server-init.cfg
done
echo "Installed Sauerbraten $release."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once; each one adds a lot of bandwidth.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for /setmaster, which gives a player admin rights. Empty turns it off.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty, anyone can join.

variables.name: Master server
variables.description: The master server the server registers with, so players find it.
